title: Factorized width × depth Mirror code in a slimmable supernet
hypothesis: A shared elastic MLP plus additive width/depth Givens codes will improve held-out width-depth configuration quality over ordinary supernet training and a byte-matched factorized scalar gain, without per-configuration private weights.
physical_object: one max-width, max-depth MLP with nested channel slices and a shared layer bank
mirror_coordinate: four width angles plus four depth angles; their sum parameterizes one final hidden-state Givens rotation
logical_multiplicity: 16 width-depth architectures from one shared physical parameter set, with four cross-combinations withheld from code training

model.architecture_sampling: US-Net/OFA sandwich: always train minimum (8,1) and maximum (32,4), plus one uniformly sampled non-held-out configuration; same minibatches and configurations for shared variants

task: Fixed synthetic 32-input, four-class teacher MLP supplies the same classification target to every width/depth subnetwork; holdout is by architecture configuration, not examples.
controls: independent full model for each width-depth configuration; all 16 payloads paid, trained on all configurations
ordinary shared elastic supernet with nested widths and variable depth
shared supernet plus additive factorized scalar gain: one value per width and depth (8 total)
shared supernet plus additive factorized Mirror Givens angle: one value per width and depth (8 total)
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent macro validation accuracy >=0.70; on the four held-out configurations, factorized Mirror reduces mean NLL by >=5% vs plain supernet and >=5% vs factorized scalar control; no seen-configuration mean NLL regression >0.02 nat vs plain; held-out mean NLL within 0.05 nat of independent; and Mirror actual bytes <=1.10x factorized scalar payload with active MACs <=1.10x plain supernet. Otherwise record FAIL/NOT ESTABLISHED and keep fresh sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds reproduce the held-out quality gates; Mirror payload <=0.90x independent-configuration payload; all 16 configurations meet held-out/test quality limits; active MACs <=1.10x plain supernet; serialized replay exact.
failure_gate: Mirror fails the held-out NLL improvement over plain supernet or matched scalar in both development seeds; or unseen configurations degrade >0.05 nat versus independent; or storage/compute budget fails.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: shared max width/depth weights and biases
all width/depth Mirror angles or scalar gains

compute.mac_equivalent_convention: one multiply-accumulate per linear weight; one MAC equivalent per multiply-then-add elementwise op

boundaries: small synthetic MLP screening only; no image, language, or production supernet claim
held-out means architecture combinations omitted from training code updates; the shared base still sees related widths and depths
logical configuration count is not independent capacity; report all 16 measured functions
fixed-update results are learning-efficiency evidence, not a near-converged capacity claim
fresh seeds remain sealed until the full development gate passes
